regions.region: page 7 top Figure 5 scale-up arrow rac-26 to S-26
regions.finding: A distinct 4 mmol scale-up uses Pd2(dba)3/L1/K2CO3 in DMSO under N2 at 30 °C with 427 nm blue LEDs, giving S-26 (1.04 g, 90%, 91% ee). The scheme prints 2.5 h while the narrative prints 4 h; the scheme prints 4 mmol while the narrative prints '4.0 mol scale'. Both conflicts are preserved.

Four independent transformations were retained: S-26/TBAF/THF at room temperature for 0.5 h to 54 (81%, 91% ee); 54/CBr4/PPh3/CH2Cl2 at 0 °C to 55 (83%, 90% ee); 54/AgNO3 in acetone/H2O for 25 h to 56 (84%, 90% ee); and 54/NIS/CH2Cl2 at -78 °C for 20 h to 57 (80%, 82% ee). Missing reagent doses and unprinted temperatures/times remain missing.
